tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search the Mozaika Publications romance catalog and published "books like" hub pages. Returns Mozaika works (title, author, URL, tropes, reader promises, series status) and matching comparison hubs and reading guides. Publisher-run; includes outside read-alikes on hub pages but no purchase links.

tools.name: books_like
tools.description: Find a published comparison hub for an outside book, show, author, or trope anchor, or a reading guide that answers a reader question (e.g. a dark romance series to binge). Returns Mozaika picks, vetted outside titles (text only), and the hub URL from Mozaika Publications.

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Get one Mozaika Publications work by author_slug and work_slug: catalog card, public chapter recap summaries, reading order hints, and canonical URL. Never returns full novel text.

tools.name: list_tropes
tools.description: List romance trope slugs and labels available in the Mozaika Publications catalog for a locale.
